alignmentMethod: Read all 48 Chinese scenes, merge consecutive narration and same-speaker dialogue into semantic blocks; fully translate each block into en-US/ja-JP/ko-KR/es-ES; retain six-locale chapter/scene/GOAL/DONE/IF/SET/OPT order. All choices, exact consequences and final hooks are translated; IF replays reuse the exact prior choice result. Line equality is structural, not padding.
changes: Replaced four compact foreign adaptations with complete scene translations including both dialogue questions, motives, consent limits and forensic timing.
Preserved Chinese story facts; combined continuous short narration and same-speaker speech without deleting it.
Replaced placeholder task-only FREE blocks with 32 real library games and localized instructions, explicitly separating icon practice from actual evidence.
Fixed two master-speaker inversions at 8.3 and 11.2: Luca now acknowledges the question he must answer instead of speaking the player’s question as his own.
Marked the dance-floor image during legal-aid testimony as recollection in all six locales; removed one duplicated months-later transition.
Added full Japanese, Korean and Spanish story bibles derived from final scenes and branches.
Replaced all 32 game invitations with distinct scene-specific waiting/action reasons in all six locales; outcome rules remain production metadata, not repeated narration.
Converted the complete zh-TW script through Foundation Hans-Hant, then normalized Taiwan vocabulary; verified all final invitations against the script.

Retained all six specific investigative task prompts from the master (stamp ink, ring childhood code, key-ring intake time, voice comparison, ledger/date cross-check, off-site backup), merged into their corresponding localized scene hook; these are real investigative actions separate from icon-game completion.
Converted the existing zh-TW story bible as well; normalized locative 裡 and Taiwan 帳/便條 vocabulary in the final traditional script and bible.

Rebuilt en-US and zh-TW bibles from the final script’s full 48 scenes and 48 exact branches; expanded cast constraints against production/character_bible_v2_2.json. Added precise authoritative ages/New York/visual and independence facts to the three new native bibles.
Kept both chapter-16 mini-games within gallery preparation, leaving the letter and final morning-street relationship decision uninterrupted by games.

parserEvidence.supported: mk94 accepts uppercase directive keys, then MG maps its first field to g_ ID; existing g_ prefix retained.
